services.desc: New clients begin with a series of private sessions. These sessions allow the instructor to develop a customized system of exercises to address each new client's needs, goals, and previous injuries. More advanced clients benefit from private instruction to improve precision, add new exercises to their Pilates workout, work on a specific issue or on rehabilitation from injury. Duet sessions are ideal for individuals who have a workout partner at the same fitness level and with similar goals, and who want to keep their sessions to two participants only. blurb: Metropolitan Pilates is a classical Pilates studio in Seattle. Dedicated to the original Pilates method developed by Joseph Pilates, our studio is committed to delivering the best fitness instruction and always addressing our client's fitness goals and previous injuries. Our workouts are designed to build strength, control, and flexibility. We are located in the University Village shopping center in north Seattle.
